modules.title: 一张卡片的 320px 到底包含什么
空间怎样从里到外计算

items.title: 内容不是全部宽度
items.text: 内容区装文字和图片；内边距在内容周围设置内侧留白，边框包住它们，外边距再使当前元素与相邻元素保持设定的外部距离。

items.title: 布局看实际占用
items.text: 当多个元素并排时，浏览器要计算它们实际占多少空间。检查开发者工具中的盒模型，才能知道挤出的是内容、padding、border 还是 margin。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 盒模型不是 Flex 或 Grid 布局。Flex 和 Grid 决定多个元素怎样排列；盒模型决定每个元素本身占多少空间。Overflow 则是在空间不够时决定内容怎样被处理。

lessonPractice.title: 两张卡片各占一半宽度，加上左右留白后却挤出页面。应该先检查什么？

options.label: 检查卡片的宽度是否还要加上内边距和边框
options.feedback: 对。卡片实际占用的空间可能超过内容宽度，先看每层尺寸最能解释两列为何排不下。

options.label: 把每张卡片宽度改成 49%，先给左右留白腾出空间
options.feedback: 把宽度改小可能暂时不溢出，但没有解释尺寸为什么超出。应先确认盒模型和 `box-sizing`，再决定宽度。

options.label: 让父容器隐藏横向溢出，把超出页面的部分裁掉
options.feedback: 隐藏溢出只会遮住问题，卡片内容仍可能被裁切；应先找出宽度、内边距和边框怎样共同占用空间。

en.title: Two cards each use `width: 50%` and each add 24px left and right padding, then overflow horizontally. What concept should you inspect first?

options.label: Inspect whether width must also account for padding and border in the box model, then choose the sizing rule
options.feedback: Correct. A card's actual space may exceed its content width, so inspecting its layers best explains why two columns no longer fit.

options.label: Inspect the search keyword because card text may be too long
options.feedback: Text length can create another issue, but the shared change here is the padding added to every card.

options.label: Inspect cross-origin settings because layout failures are usually CORS
options.feedback: CORS governs cross-origin reads, not CSS size calculation.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查这两列卡片的盒模型，说明内容宽度、padding、border 和 margin 各占多少。桌面上保持两列，390px 时不能横向溢出；改完后用开发者工具确认实际尺寸。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Inspect the box model of these two-column cards and state the space used by content width, padding, border, and margin. Keep two columns on desktop and prevent horizontal overflow at 390px; afterward confirm the computed size in developer tools.

learning.assumes: You have adjusted a card's width, padding, or border.
learning.outcome: You can inspect an element's content, padding, border, and margin and explain why its actual footprint differs from expectation.

modules.title: How space is calculated from inside out

items.title: Content is not the whole width
items.text: The content box holds text and images; padding creates breathing room, border wraps them, and margin separates the element from its neighbors.

items.title: Layout uses the actual footprint
items.text: When elements sit side by side, the browser calculates the space they truly occupy. DevTools box-model inspection shows whether content, padding, border, or margin caused the squeeze.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: The box model is not Flex or Grid. Flex and Grid arrange multiple elements; the box model determines the footprint of each element. Overflow decides what happens when there is not enough space.
